name: time-picker
title: Time Picker
description: Wall-clock time field with direct input, hour/minute selection and configurable time bounds or steps.
docs: Import the installed moru/styles.css once in your application entry. Wrap Moru components in MoruProvider from moru/provider. mode defaults to light; pass mode="dark" for dark defaults. This beta is tested with Vite + React; Next.js SSR and React Native are not verified. Shared core CSS is installed once; fonts are optional and are not downloaded by this registry. Keep moru/_licenses/Moru-LICENSE when redistributing source. Guide: https://github.com/syrus-riius/moru-ui/blob/main/docs/registry.ko.md
